brief: Prioritize Kingsley Green for pre-event attention and bring forward its detailed inspection before the heat event, as its cooling system is unverified due to overdue maintenance under REG-042. Because it is an ageing unit facing heat exposure, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure if it cannot be attended prior to the event per MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified according to MG-021.
